spec.description:
Foilboard Spacer Blocks are pre-cut expanded polystyrene (EPS)
blocks designed to maintain a consistent, non-collapsible reflective airspace
between Foilboard insulation panels and external wall claddings or internal
linings. By establishing a guaranteed 20mm or 25mm still air cavity adjacent to
the reflective aluminum foil face, they ensure the assembly achieves its rated
total thermal R-value. Adhered or mechanically fixed between framing members,
they prevent panels from flexing, dislocating, or touching adjacent cladding
under wind loads.
features:
Guarantees a permanent 20mm or 25mm
reflective still air cavity

Ensures Foilboard systems achieve rated total
system R-values

Constructed from lightweight, fire-retardant expanded
polystyrene (EPS)

Prevents panel deflection and rattling against cladding
under wind pressure

Pre-cut blocks allow rapid, consistent on-site
placement

Compatible with all Foilboard panel thicknesses and framing
systems
Moisture-proof and rot-proof, will not degrade or sag over time
Eliminates guesswork in establishing compliant airspace dimensions

technical.value: Approx. 50 mm x 50 mm x 20/25 mm (or 100 mm x 50 mm)

spec.fire:
Fire-retardant EPS; compliant as a system
component with NCC fire hazard requirements
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1,
AS 3999, NCC Volume One and Two
spec.sustainability:
100% recyclable EPS; zero
CFC/HCFC; low VOC emissions
install:
Determine required airspace depth
(20mm or 25mm) from system architectural specification

Position Foilboard
Spacer Blocks onto wall studs, battens, or the back of Foilboard panels

Adhere blocks using approved construction adhesive or tack in place with
fasteners

Place approximately one spacer block per square meter or at 600mm
to 900mm intervals along framing

Install Foilboard panel firmly against
spacer blocks

Fasten panel to structural framing ensuring spacer blocks
maintain the designed airspace

Verify panels remain planar without bowing
into the adjacent cladding cavity
selection_checklist:
Confirm required
airspace depth (20mm or 25mm) from thermal R-value calculation

Calculate
total quantity needed based on wall area (approx. 4-6 blocks per standard
panel)

Verify framing type (timber studs, steel girts, or masonry furring
channels)
Order compatible solvent-free adhesive or fasteners
limitations:
Do not use
solvent-based adhesives which dissolve expanded polystyrene

Spacer blocks are
non-structural and do not replace primary mechanical framing fasteners

Do not
expose to continuous service temperatures above 80°C
spec.warranty:
Covered
under Foilboard 25-year performance warranty system

problem_keywords: maintaining 20mm air gap for foil insulation
use_cases:
Maintaining a guaranteed 20mm or 25mm reflective airspace behind external
wall claddings

Preventing Foilboard panels from flexing into cavity brickwork
or lightweight cladding

Spacing panels off masonry walls to create a still
reflective thermal cavity
not_for: Underfloor joist cradle suspension (use Floor Saddles)
retrieval.rag_summary:
Foilboard Spacer Blocks are
pre-cut 20mm and 25mm fire-retardant EPS blocks designed to maintain a
consistent, uncompressed reflective airspace between Foilboard panels and
adjacent building claddings. By establishing the required still air cavity, they
ensure Foilboard systems achieve their certified total thermal R-values while
preventing panels from flexing under wind loads. Moisture-proof and rot-proof,
they provide a reliable, low-cost solution for cavity depth management across
framed walls and ceilings.
